source_evidence: Insight is expressed in current source, verified against working-tree src/path.cpp (sha256 c9f46e404f94a7635ac13c66f85de4154700fd4fca9328e11acb68a247ad1b00, the same digest the request diagnostics measured): scoped #pragma function(memset) at src/path.cpp:70-72 ahead of Path::init (definition line 96, memset(map_table_, 0, MapArea * 4) at line 103) and Path::find (line 418), #pragma intrinsic(memset) restored at src/path.cpp:1396-1398 immediately ahead of Path::continents (definition line 1400), and #pragma function(memset) re-enabled at src/path.cpp:1562-1564 ahead of Path::sensors (definition line 1566, ZeroMemory at line 1568); the supersession note at src/path.cpp:65-69 records the rationale, and no memset_call forwarder definition remains in the file (only historical comment mentions at lines 65 and 84-85).

Boundary of this decision: incorporation records the structural insight only, not behavioral or acceptance proof. init's and merge's strict measurements remain unknown on the outside MapArea/Continents data-global bindings and merge's map_tiles relocation offset 77 - those stay fully pending as worker-aa46f3ca8c534a0f999d12438af84fe6 and worker-63d9865e42f6447ca5b5f225c015344c; the affected entities Path::init (entity-9453a459...), Path::find (entity-ad68dc9f...) and Path::sensors (entity-289ccd16...) are all inside current task scope, and no outside file, baseline change, byte-claim demotion or source acceptance is granted.
